info.title: AlphaLoops FMCSA Carrier Data API
info.description:
Fleet intelligence API for looking up FMCSA-registered carriers by DOT number, MC number, or company name. Access carrier profiles with 200+ fields, safety data, authority history, fleet equipment, inspections, crashes, news, and decision-maker contacts.

Base URL: https://api.runalphaloops.com

API access is available exclusively on the Enterprise plan. Contact sales at https://runalphaloops.com/contact to get your API key.

get.summary: Look up a carrier by DOT number
get.description: Returns the full carrier profile with 200+ fields including identity, authority, safety, fleet, technology stack, and contacts. Use the fields parameter to project only the fields you need.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return (e.g. "legal_name,power_units,latitude,longitude"). Omit to return all fields.

get.summary: Look up a carrier by MC/MX docket number
get.description: Returns the full carrier profile (same fields as the DOT lookup). Supports the same ?fields= projection parameter.

parameters.name: mc_number
parameters.description: The carrier's MC or MX docket number

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return. Omit to return all fields.

get.summary: Match a company to a carrier by name
get.description: Match a company to a carrier by name, domain, state, and city. Returns ranked results with a confidence score. At minimum, company_name is required.

parameters.name: company_name
parameters.description: Company name to match against (fuzzy matching)

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Company website domain (e.g. "swifttrans.com") — improves match accuracy

200.description: Paginated search results with confidence scores

get.summary: Get carrier operating authority history
get.description: Returns all authority actions including grants, revocations, and reinstatements.

get.summary: Get carrier truck (power unit) fleet
get.description: Returns the carrier's registered truck fleet. Includes VIN, make, model, engine specs, weight, and manufacturing details.

get.summary: Get carrier trailer fleet
get.description: Returns the carrier's registered trailer fleet. Includes VIN, manufacturer, type, and reefer status.

get.summary: Get carrier inspection history
get.description: Returns roadside inspection history with metadata and out-of-service counts. Use /v1/inspections/{inspection_id}/violations to get violation details for a specific inspection.

get.summary: Get violations for a specific inspection
get.description: Retrieve all violations from a specific roadside inspection. Use the inspection report number returned from the Inspections endpoint.

get.summary: Get carrier crash history
get.description: Returns reported crash history with details, severity, and contributing factors.

get.summary: Get carrier news and press mentions
get.description: Returns recent news articles and press mentions related to the carrier.

get.summary: Find people at a carrier company
get.description: Returns professional profiles including name, title, seniority, social profiles, and industry. Use dot_number or company_name to search. Note: This endpoint may return HTTP 202 with a Retry-After header if contacts are still being fetched — retry after the specified delay.

parameters.name: company_name
parameters.description: Company name to search (required if dot_number not provided)

202.description: Contacts are being fetched asynchronously. Retry after the delay specified in the Retry-After header.

get.summary: Enrich a contact profile
get.description: Returns verified emails, phone numbers, skills, full work history, education, and social profiles. Consumes 1 enrichment credit per new lookup (cached results are free). Returns HTTP 402 when credits are exhausted.

post.description: Filtered search with include/exclude conditions, geo-radius search, sorting, and field projection. No company name required — filter by state, fleet size, cargo type, technology, authority status, revenue, and more.

get.summary: Get carrier insurance filings
get.description: Retrieve insurance filings (BIPD, cargo, bond) for a carrier from the FMCSA insurance table. Includes policy numbers, coverage limits, and insurer details.

parameters.name: insurance_type
parameters.description: Filter by insurance type code (e.g. BIPD, CARGO, BOND)

parameters.name: insurer
parameters.description: Partial match on insurance company name

get.summary: Get carrier insurance filings by MC number
get.description: Retrieve insurance filings by MC docket number. Same response shape and filters as the DOT-based insurance endpoint.

parameters.name: insurer
parameters.description: Partial match on insurance company name

get.summary: Get carrier change-event and authority timeline
get.description: Merged chronological feed of carrier change events and authority history. Combines field-level changes from monthly FMCSA census diffs (contact, address, fleet, operations, authority, people) with authority history records.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Comma-separated categories: contact, address, fleet, operations, authority, people

200.description: Merged timeline of change events and authority actions

get.summary: Get authority-for-sale listings for a carrier
get.description: Returns any authority-for-sale listings (Facebook groups, Telegram channels, BizBuySell, etc.) linked to this carrier's DOT number, with seller info, asking prices, post URLs, and matching reasoning. Returns found: false with mc_sale: null when no listings are linked.

200.description: Authority-for-sale listings, or a found: false sentinel when none are linked

get.summary: Get carrier fleet VINs listed for sale
get.description: Cross-references the VINs this carrier has been inspected with against a marketplace dataset of trucks and trailers currently (or recently) listed for sale. Returns one row per matching VIN, sorted by most recent inspection date. Empty results are common.

get.summary: Get a carrier's relationship graph
get.description: Retrieve a carrier's corporate connections graph — shared officers, addresses, phones, emails, and equipment linking it to other carriers.

get.summary: Get aggregated carrier risk signals
get.description: Aggregated carrier risk assessment in a single call. Returns an AI-generated risk score (0-10) and level, plus six signal categories — authority-for-sale listings, equipment-for-sale marketplace matches, financial-distress indicators, fraud/chameleon patterns, historical authority/insurance/change-event patterns, and recent news sentiment. Each category carries a derived level of "high", "medium", "clear", or "unknown". The risk summary is cached; pass force_refresh=true to force regeneration.

parameters.name: force_refresh
parameters.description: Set to true to bypass the cached risk summary and regenerate it from current signals (slower).

parameters.name: include_equipment
parameters.description: Set to false to skip the equipment-marketplace VIN lookup for a faster response.

200.description: Scored risk header plus six derived signal categories

get.summary: Find carriers similar to a given carrier
get.description: Find carriers similar to the specified carrier based on fleet size, location, cargo type, and other attributes.

get.summary: Get an AI-generated carrier overview
get.description: Returns an AI-generated summary overview of a carrier including key highlights.

get.summary: Get inspection history for a VIN
get.description: Look up the inspection history for a VIN. Returns the unique DOT numbers the VIN has been associated with (with last date seen on each), plus the unique FIPS-coded county locations where the VIN has been inspected. Capped at the 5,000 most-recent inspections; successful responses are edge-cached for 24h.

parameters.name: vin
parameters.description: Vehicle Identification Number (case-insensitive — normalized to uppercase server-side)

200.description: VIN inspection history aggregated by DOT and location

get.summary: Look up one or more VINs
get.description: For each VIN, returns its FMCSA inspection-unit history, most recent sighting, every DOT it has been associated with, and whether it has ever been listed for sale. Accepts a single VIN or a comma-separated list via query params. Max 100 VINs per request; results preserve input order and include misses (found: false).

parameters.name: vin
parameters.description: A single VIN to look up (e.g. ?vin=3AKJHHDR3RSUV5213). Case-insensitive.

200.description: Per-VIN lookup results in input order

post.description: Batch form of the VIN lookup. Send a JSON array of VINs in the request body. Max 100 VINs per request; results preserve input order and include misses (found: false).

vins.description: Array of VINs to look up (max 100)

200.description: Per-VIN lookup results in input order

bearerAuth.description: API key provided by AlphaLoops. Include as: Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY

RateLimited.description: Too many requests. Check X-RateLimit-Remaining and Retry-After headers.

power_units_12m.description: Net power unit change over 12 months

power_units_24m.description: Net power unit change over 24 months

CarrierProfile.description: Full carrier profile with 200+ fields. Key fields shown below — use ?fields= to project specific fields.

EnrichedContact.description: Enriched contact profile with verified emails, phone numbers, work history, education, and social profiles. Consumes 1 enrichment credit per new lookup.

CarrierQueryRequest.description: Filter body for POST /v1/carriers/query. All fields optional.

include.description: Filter conditions to include. Supports scalar equality, arrays, range objects ({ min, max }), and a location object ({ latitude, longitude, radius_miles }).

exclude.description: Filter conditions to exclude (same shape as include).

fields.description: Fields to return on each result (e.g. ["dot_number", "legal_name", "power_units"]).

sort_by.description: Sort field: power_units, drivers, date_added, safety_rating, annual_revenue, distance, etc.

results.description: Carrier objects projected to the requested fields (or default fields when fields is omitted). When a geo-radius filter is used, each result includes distance_miles.

EquipmentForSaleItem.description: A fleet VIN matched to a marketplace listing. equipment_type determines which extra fields are populated.

connectionType.description: shared_officer, shared_address, shared_phone, shared_email, shared_truck, shared_trailer, shared_surname

RiskSignalLevel.description: Derived severity for a single signal category.

risk_level.description: CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW, CLEAR, or UNKNOWN

summary_available.description: False when the upstream summary service was unavailable and a carrier-stored fallback was used.

truncated.description: True when capped at 5,000 inspections; aggregations are over the returned sample.
